name: Kodiboxarr
description: Kodibox TV / Vavoo source support for Dispatcharr. Watches Kodibox builds, imports playlist and EPG metadata, and prepares runtime-resolved stream placeholders.
author: Mildman1848 + Hermes Agent

fields.label: Safety: max removed channels (%)
fields.help_text: Stop sync if more channels vanish.

fields.label: Channel import start number
fields.help_text: Start number for auto-created Kodiboxarr test channels.

fields.label: Channel import limit
fields.help_text: Max channels to create per apply run. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Channel import mode
fields.help_text: test_batch imports next streams; epg_only imports only streams with EPG match; all_missing imports all pending streams if limit=0.

actions.label: 1. Check Kodibox build
actions.description: Read manifest and report build metadata.

actions.label: 2. Dry-run sync
actions.description: Parse build and generate snapshot/diff without writing Dispatcharr models.

actions.label: 3. Sync
actions.description: Write generated M3U, stream profile and EPG source into Dispatcharr after safety gates pass.

actions.label: Assign stream profile
actions.description: Assign the Kodiboxarr stream profile to imported streams and linked Channels.

actions.label: 4. Mapping report
actions.description: Analyze Kodiboxarr streams, manual-channel conflicts, duplicate tvg-id values and EPG coverage without writing.

actions.label: 5. Dry-run channel plan
actions.description: Plan safe auto-created Dispatcharr channels from imported Kodiboxarr streams without writing.

actions.label: 6. Apply channel plan
actions.description: Create marker-protected Dispatcharr channels for planned Kodiboxarr streams.

actions.label: 7. Dry-run delete Kodiboxarr channels
actions.description: Show marker-protected Kodiboxarr channels that would be removed.

actions.label: Delete Kodiboxarr test channels
actions.description: Remove only channels auto-created by this Kodiboxarr M3U account.
